label: Production
short: A process that runs on an AI tool on a regular schedule, staged by who starts it.
strong: A process runs on its own. Does someone own it when it breaks? If not, that is the next task.
middle: A process exists and a person starts it each time. One afternoon makes it run alone, and a listed person can do that afternoon.
edge: Nothing runs on a schedule yet. The first one is a digest or a triage, built once and handed over. Talk to someone who has built one.
unmet: Ask whether any report, digest or triage arrives with nobody sending it.

route.title: Talk to someone who has built one
